opponents.description: The persisted race_opponent_summary sections per opponent, as plain text, hydrated by gp-api. NOT raw collected pages. This text plus candidate_platform is the ONLY factual source for card copy.

opponent_name.description: The opponent this summary is about. Echoed verbatim as opponent_name on cards that contrast against them.

threat_tier.description: The persisted summary's relative threat tier. Drives card ordering: primary_threat angles first, then watch_closely, then low_priority.

overview_text.description: The summary's overview section text, or null when the summary carried none.

background_text.description: The summary's background section text, or null when the summary carried none.

issues_that_matter.description: The summary's issues_that_matter bullet strings, or null when the summary carried none.

candidate_platform.description: The candidate's own platform, hydrated by gp-api from Website.content.about (same shape race_opponent_summary consumes). Candidate-side claims on cards come only from here. Absent or thin means fewer cards.

bio.description: The candidate's own biography paragraph, as captured for their candidate site.

issues.description: The candidate's own issue positions. A card's candidate-side commitment is drawn only from these, never invented.

description.description: The candidate's own stated stance on this issue.

state.description: 2-letter state code (e.g. NC), from gp-api's DistrictResolverService. Top-level and flat on purpose: the dispatch Lambda's scope derivation reads params.state to build the broker's auto-injected Residence_Addresses_State predicate, and reserves the top-level param name 'district' as a scope string (an object there fails dispatch). Present only together with the l2_district_* pair.

l2_district_type.description: L2 voter file column name for the district (e.g. City, City_Ward), from gp-api's DistrictResolverService. Absent when the org has no resolvable position; then the agent skips Databricks entirely and every card goes out numberless (haystaq_status: no_district).

l2_district_name.description: L2 district value to match (e.g. HENDERSONVILLE CITY). Absent together with l2_district_type.

race_context.description: The race the opponents are running in, hydrated by gp-api. Light context for phrasing only (office / jurisdiction / election date). The agent does NOT reason over it to add facts.

election_date.description: The election date for this race, or null.

haystaq_status.description: How the district sentiment step went: district_scoped when at least one card carries district Haystaq numbers; no_coverage when queries ran but no column survived the coverage rule and cell-size floor (or the district value never matched); no_district when the state/l2_district_* params were absent and Databricks was skipped entirely.

actions.description: Up to 5 distinct stand-out action cards, in threat order. Fewer when the field or platform supports fewer distinct angles; never padded.

title.description: Action-framed title naming the opponent and issue (e.g. 'Stand out against Jeff Groh on housing affordability').

body.description: At most 3 sentences: the opponent's stance or silence, the district Haystaq percentages when coverage exists (stating voters care about or lean on the issue), and the candidate's own commitment. Carries no statistic when coverage is missing.

sms_message.description: First-person candidate voice, plain factual contrast, sendable as-is. Only facts present in the input summaries and platform.

opponent_name.description: The input opponent this card contrasts against, echoed verbatim. Null only for an issue-ownership card the field's text supports without naming one opponent.

issue.description: The issue this card contrasts on. At most one card per opponent+issue pair.
